basis_note: Reads across this case's full built chain - DFAPTI (77 evidence items), DFAPTA (12 paths), Lattice Atlas (5 emergent patterns), SHM Gate (13 mechanisms), Temporal Projection Integrity Engine (7 forward assessments), Enforcement Notice (10 remedies, 4 recipients), and Advocacy Package - plus this repository's own ingestion decisions (DEC-0001 through DEC-0006) and contradiction findings (CTR-0001 through CTR-0004). Each entry below is assessed against what this case actually contains, not assumed from the catalogue definition alone.

functions.name: Enforcement
functions.definition: The methodology produces findings with evidentiary discipline sufficient to route to bodies with standing.
functions.match_note: A submission-ready Enforcement Notice exists, naming Nambucca Valley Council, NSW DCCEEW, Commonwealth DCCEEW and Destination NSW, with ten remedy demands and a stated legislative basis for each recipient's jurisdiction.

functions.name: Translation
functions.definition: Converts inaccessible governance documentation into findings legible to the people governed by it.
functions.match_note: The Camphor Laurel biosecurity/EPBC intersection (AR-010) and the camp-registration/grant-eligibility mechanism (AR-003, AR-004) translate three overlapping legislative instruments - the Biosecurity Act, the EPBC Act, and the Flying-Fox Camp Management Policy - into a single plain finding a resident can act on.

functions.name: Pattern Detection
functions.definition: Documents a convergence across actors that no single actor can see.
functions.match_note: Lattice Atlas's Corridor Duplication finding (Emergent Pattern 4) is only visible by reading this case together with the adjacent Bellbrook case - neither council, on its own record, treats the two colonies as one regional pattern.

functions.name: Power Redistribution
functions.definition: Makes investigative power portable to any operator, no institutional backing required.
functions.status: Active - this case is a direct instance
functions.match_note: This case is itself the demonstration: a private individual produced a 77-item evidentiary chain through Enforcement Notice against a council, a state department and a Commonwealth department, with no institutional backing, legal credentials, or regulator standing.

functions.name: Lived Experience Protection
functions.definition: Classifies lived experience as primary evidence; institutional dismissal becomes a finding.
functions.match_note: Vicki Provost's 16 March 2023 account, as recorded in council's own minutes, is treated as the founding evidence item (EV-0006) for the entire case - not downgraded to anecdote at any stage of DFAPTA or the SHM Gate.

functions.name: Legibility
functions.definition: Makes governance instruments understandable to the people they govern.
functions.match_note: The Lattice Atlas and DFAPTA together make legible what council's obligations are, what the grant program requires, and what the camp-registration mechanism is - none of which appear connected anywhere in council's own public material.

functions.name: Containment
functions.definition: Names a structural harm mechanism so it can no longer operate invisibly.
functions.match_note: The SHM Gate names and documents 13 structural harm mechanisms as operative in this case, each independently checked against the current 68-mechanism catalogue and confirmed correct.

functions.name: Temporal Inversion
functions.definition: Time loads onto the institution, not the citizen.
functions.status: Active - directly named in this case's own material
functions.match_note: This case's own Mechanism 10 (Time as Structural Harm Mechanism) states the exact mechanism: the 37-month response void is not silence but a structural record - documented across four checked points in council's own tracking register.

functions.name: Reflexive Audit
functions.definition: MAYHEM's own primitives applied to MAYHEM itself.
functions.match_note: This case's own ingestion applied MAYHEM's evidentiary discipline to MAYHEM's own prior output: an unverified external citation in the frozen Temporal Projection Integrity Engine was found and excluded (CTR-0001), and a mechanism-count inconsistency between two of the case's own frozen documents was found and preserved rather than silently reconciled (CTR-0002).

functions.name: Impossibility Demonstration
functions.definition: Converts closure of every remediation surface into evidence of structural impossibility of self-remediation.
functions.status: Not directly evidenced for this case
functions.match_note: This case's DFAPTA does not include a dedicated self-remediation assessment path (unlike DFAPTI-BB-LW-2026-00001's AR-010). Individual paths touch on the community's lack of standing (AR-001, Mechanism 43), but no path in this case systematically closes off every available remediation surface to demonstrate impossibility. Not claimed.

functions.name: Divergence Preservation
functions.definition: Preserves disagreement rather than silently reconciling it.
functions.match_note: Four contradictions are preserved rather than resolved by assumption: an unverified external citation (CTR-0001), a mechanism-count discrepancy (CTR-0002), a weakened remedy pathway found via a real DCCEEW reply (CTR-0003), and a citation error in the case's own Mechanism Register (CTR-0004, logged and then reverted after operator correction - see this case's own decisions.json for that exact sequence).

citizen_tools.name: The Evidence Register
citizen_tools.definition: A blank, paper-ready, append-only template for documenting evidence.
citizen_tools.match_note: 77 evidence items, append-only, each carrying source, classification, and verification status.

citizen_tools.name: The Advocacy Package
citizen_tools.definition: The complete investigation output combined with recipient guidance.
citizen_tools.match_note: Built and live, naming who has standing, how to submit, how to log responses, and how to verify findings.

citizen_tools.name: Five-Step Primary Source Verification
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches any person to verify a finding against its primary source.
citizen_tools.match_note: Present in the Advocacy Package, with a worked example against EV-0038/EV-0039 - a real WebSearch corroboration attempt, including the case where a direct fetch failed and a weaker method was used and disclosed.

citizen_tools.name: Recipient Routing
citizen_tools.definition: Names bodies with standing, their legislative basis, and the remedy addressed to each.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Enforcement Notice routes ten remedies across four recipients, each with a stated jurisdictional basis; the Advocacy Package explains who has standing for which finding.

citizen_tools.name: Lived Experience Documentation Protocol
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches affected people to document their own experience as primary evidence.
citizen_tools.status: Partially demonstrated, not built as a standalone artifact
citizen_tools.match_note: EV-0006 is a real instance of lived experience treated as primary evidence, but this case does not build a standalone protocol document a new resident could use to do the same for themselves.

citizen_tools.name: Reclassification Recognition Training
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches recognition of institutional reclassification patterns in real time.
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced - no training artifact exists in this case's built material.

citizen_tools.name: Institutional Response Log
citizen_tools.definition: Logs every institutional response - date, form, content, classification.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package's 'Logging Responses' section provides the template and instructions; no actual log entries exist yet since sending has not been confirmed (Q-0011, THR-03).

citizen_tools.name: Harm Narration Construction
citizen_tools.definition: Constructs evidence-anchored harm narration for different audiences.
citizen_tools.status: Not built as a repository artifact
citizen_tools.match_note: The original source material included a Plain Language Summary document; it was read during ingestion but not built into this repository as a live page. Not claimed here.

citizen_tools.name: Onward Training Capability
citizen_tools.definition: Designed to be passed on by anyone who has worked through it.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package's How to Submit and If There's No Response sections are written for a reader with no prior MAYHEM knowledge, requiring no specialist background to use.

citizen_tools.name: Operator Curriculum
citizen_tools.definition: Trains operators to run MAYHEM investigations across competency grades.
citizen_tools.status: Not applicable to a single investigation
citizen_tools.match_note: This is a methodology-level tool, not something a single case produces.

citizen_tools.name: Paper-Ready Templates
citizen_tools.definition: Working instruments applying the methodology with no digital dependency.
citizen_tools.status: Not distinctly built for this case
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced as a case-specific artifact beyond the general Advocacy Package content.

citizen_tools.name: Non-Allegatory Framing
citizen_tools.definition: Describes system behaviour, never attributes intent or motivation.
citizen_tools.match_note: Every finding across DFAPTA, Lattice Atlas, and the SHM Gate describes documented absence or process, not council's intent - consistent with this repository's own separately-established allegation-free discipline.

citizen_tools.name: Federation as Mutual Legibility
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple independent registers whose convergence produces legibility no single one can.
citizen_tools.match_note: This case's Regional Corridor Finding explicitly links to DFAPTI-BB-FF-2026-00001 as a parallel, independent register - two communities, two registers, one structural observation.

citizen_tools.name: Temporal Accumulation as Citizen Power
citizen_tools.definition: Absence and delay become evidence that strengthens the citizen's case over time.
citizen_tools.match_note: Directly demonstrated by Mechanism 10 / Function 8 above - the 37-month absence from council's own tracking register is itself the evidentiary record.

citizen_tools.name: Cross-Domain Pattern Detection
citizen_tools.definition: Surfaces convergence across health, housing, disability and other domains for the same person.
citizen_tools.match_note: This case is single-domain (wildlife/biosecurity governance); it does not cross into other governance domains for the same affected population.

citizen_tools.name: Community Evidence Aggregation
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple people's accounts of the same system, aggregated without institutional processing.
citizen_tools.match_note: Only one named resident's account (Vicki Provost) appears in this case's register; no multi-resident aggregation was built.

citizen_tools.name: Structural Literacy as Preventative Tool
citizen_tools.definition: Lets a citizen recognise a harm mechanism before it completes.
citizen_tools.status: Not evidenced as forward-preventative for this case
citizen_tools.match_note: This case's findings are retrospective, documenting a 37-month-old failure already complete, not applied to catch a harm still in progress. The Bellbrook cross-reference is the closest instance, but even there the equivalent failure is already well underway, not caught early.

citizen_tools.name: Parallel Verification as Democratic Infrastructure
citizen_tools.definition: Any completed investigation can be independently re-verified using the same methodology.
citizen_tools.match_note: This repository independently re-checked all 13 mechanism claims in the original Mechanism Register against the current catalogue (all confirmed) and independently corroborated EV-0038/EV-0039 via WebSearch - a real instance of parallel verification strengthening the original findings.

citizen_tools.name: Yield Without Enforcement
citizen_tools.definition: Chain completion is determined by yield delivery, not enforcement notice production.
citizen_tools.status: Active - the organising principle of this page
citizen_tools.match_note: This case's DFAPTA, Lattice Atlas, and SHM Gate already deliver legibility, structural visibility, and naming capacity regardless of whether the Enforcement Notice is ever sent or acted on - that yield does not wait on enforcement.

not_claimed: This gate does not claim every catalogue entry above is fully or perfectly delivered - several are marked 'not evidenced' or 'partially demonstrated' rather than forced into a positive claim.

This gate does not claim intent by any institution named in this case. Every assessment above describes what this case's own material demonstrates, consistent with this case's non-allegatory framing throughout.
This gate does not re-verify the underlying EV- items cited as anchors - their verification status remains exactly as recorded in this case's own evidence register.
This is this repository's own reading of the catalogue against this case's material, not a claim of the operator's final or complete assessment.
